cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Assigned by Procedure
cards.instruction: Get someone to accept an unwanted responsibility by proving that the rules, rotation, or tradition make it theirs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Congratulations on becoming club president. Here are the toilet keys.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought the caretaker cleaned them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. We voted to save that fee. The minutes assign closing and cleaning to the president.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I proposed that when you were president.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, and I cleaned them all year. Your first presidential duty is continuing your savings.

mechanism: A supervises a presidency handover by correcting assumptions about paid cleaning and applying B's own rule to B's new office.
confusable: A personal revenge request differs from D173; minutes and continuity of the role must support assignment.
comparison: Elected-office savings differ from a private household rota.
seedUse: Keep B's old proposal and A's year of cleaning; make the final action a concrete handover rather than a summary of savings.
